conversation.text: Je had hem net nog bij je.
conversation.translation: You had it with you just now.

conversation.text: Ja, voor we in die attractie gingen.
conversation.translation: Yes, before we went on that ride.

conversation.text: Heb je hem daar laten liggen?
Mijn telefoon en portemonnee zitten erin.
conversation.translation: My phone and wallet are in it.
Come on, we're going back. Quick.

conversation.text: Wacht, wat heb jij daar om je schouder?
conversation.translation: Wait, what do you have there on your shoulder?

conversation.text: Eh, jouw tas. Ik schrok me dood. Sorry, je vroeg of ik hem even wilde dragen.
conversation.translation: Uh, your bag. I got the fright of my life. Sorry, you asked if I'd carry it for a moment.
